## Summary

`tests/conftest.py` has **two** ways a data-dependent test gets skipped in the credential-free `unit-tests` job, and they cost wildly different amounts:

| path | when it fires | cost |
|---|---|---|
| `pytestmark = pytest.mark.requires_s3` | **collection time** | free |
| `pytest_runtest_makereport` net | **after** the test runs, attempts DVC→S3, and fails | a full network timeout, per test |

The second is a safety net, and its own skip message says so:

> "Skipped: no S3 credentials, so this test cannot build country data. **Add `requires_s3` from tests/conftest.py to skip it explicitly.**"

Measured on the last green run ([34751527886](https://github.com/ligon/LSMS_Library/actions/runs/34751527886), `development` @ `a90c61cd0`, 2,639 passed / 1,524 skipped in **1 h 58 m**): **56 test files produce skips while containing no `requires_s3` mention at all, accounting for ~1,225 of the 1,524 skips — about 80%.** Every one of those pays a network timeout to arrive at a skip that marking would have made free.

This is almost certainly where the two hours are. The ten slowest files by wall time, reconstructed from log timestamps, are **all** unmarked:

```
 16.4 min  test_tanzania_grain_gh323.py
 11.9 min  test_feature_canonical_index.py
  9.8 min  test_sample.py
  8.8 min  test_age_dtype_consistency.py
  8.1 min  test_currency.py
  7.7 min  test_currency_denominated_units.py
  7.7 min  test_table_structure.py
  6.8 min  test_ghanalss_nutrition.py
  5.4 min  test_add_market_index_dedup.py
  3.6 min  test_gh323_tanzania_cluster_key.py
```

## Why this is better than "run fewer tests"

The obvious reaction to a 2-hour CI job is to be more selective. That would be the wrong first move here: these tests are **already not running** — the job skips 1,524 of 4,163 items. We are not paying for coverage, we are paying for the *discovery* that we decided not to run them. Marking removes the cost without removing a single test from the suite.

Only after this should selectivity be considered, against the ~2,639 tests that actually execute.

## Proposed work

1. Add `pytestmark = pytest.mark.requires_s3` to the 56 files below (module level — the usual shape is a module-scoped fixture that builds a country).
2. Where a file mixes data-dependent and data-free tests, mark the tests rather than the module, so the data-free ones keep running in CI. **This needs care: a blanket module mark would silently stop running genuinely data-free tests**, which is the one way this change could lose coverage. Diff the pass count per file before/after.
3. Re-measure the job and record the new figure.
4. Consider whether the runtime net should then *warn* rather than silently convert — once marking is complete, an unmarked credential failure is a missing mark, and saying so keeps the file list from regrowing.

## Verification for the fix

The invariant is that the **passed** count must not move, only the wall time and where the skips are decided:

```
before:  2,639 passed / 1,524 skipped / 1 h 58 m
after:   2,639 passed / 1,524 skipped / <<  1 h 58 m
```

A drop in `passed` means a module mark was too broad (point 2).

## Related

- #906 bounds and parallelises the job (`-n auto`, `--timeout`, `--durations`) without changing test selection — it makes this work measurable, and is not a substitute for it.
- `tests/conftest.py`'s header already records why the net exists (four PRs turned red by environmental failures in one day, #625/#641/#644/#632). Nothing here weakens the net; it stops it being the *primary* mechanism.

## Measured now that #906 is merged — the hypothesis is confirmed, and the mechanism is visible

#906 landed and gave the job `--durations=25`. First green run on `development` after the merge ([34761645883](https://github.com/ligon/LSMS_Library/actions/runs/34761645883)):

| | before (34751527886) | after (34761645883) |
|---|---|---|
| wall time | **118 min** | **27 min** |
| passed | 2,639 | 2,644 |
| skipped | **1,524** | **1,524** |

Skips unchanged, and the +5 passed is exactly the five tests #899 added — so parallelism cost no coverage. **But #906 only divided the work across workers; it did not remove any.** The durations now show what is actually being paid for.

## 20 of the 25 slowest entries sit in a 3-second band

```
512.32s call   test_feature_canonical_index.py::test_warm_corpus_assembly_loses_no_rows
256.68s setup  test_sample.py::TestSample::test_index_is_i_t[Albania]
135.37s setup  test_ghanalss_nutrition.py::test_grain_is_household_wave
 74.24s setup  test_sample.py::TestSample::test_index_is_i_t[Azerbaijan]
---------------------------------------------------------------- the band:
 45.13s setup  test_table_structure.py::TestHousingVDtype::test_v_is_string_dtype[Kazakhstan]
 44.03s call   test_visualizations.py::test_uganda_nonfood_table_is_long_and_draws_since_gh817
 43.64s call   test_age_dtype_consistency.py::test_age_dtype_is_float64[Tanzania]
 43.21s call   test_currency.py::test_country_default_is_backward_compatible
 43.18s call   test_currency_denominated_units.py::test_ghanalss_unitvalue_and_units_modes_are_unaffected
 43.17s setup  test_gh842_uganda_harvest_unit.py::test_2018_19_season_B_serves_a_real_unit
 43.06s call   test_gh323_benin_togo.py::test_plot_inputs_recovers_the_discarded_line_item[Benin-...]
 43.00s setup  test_tanzania_grain_gh323.py::test_sample_is_unique_per_household_round
 42.96s setup  test_uganda_crop_condition.py::test_condition_is_an_index_level
 42.96s call   test_currency_denominated_units.py::test_ghanalss_food_prices_is_one_wave_and_not_constant
 42.94s setup  test_uganda_sold_unit.py::test_shipped_counts_reproduce
 42.82s setup  test_tanzania_community_cluster_xwalk.py::test_grain_and_uniqueness
 42.77s setup  test_togo_nonfood_expenditures.py::test_every_reported_line_item_survives
 42.74s setup  test_sample.py::TestSample::test_index_is_i_t[Ethiopia]
 42.72s setup  test_ghanalss_community_prices.py::test_index_and_columns
 42.71s call   test_tanzania_grain_gh323.py::test_all_four_rounds_survive[sample]
 42.56s setup  test_tanzania_grain_gh323.py::test_no_empty_string_geography[Region]
 42.55s call   test_gh323_benin_togo.py::test_plot_inputs_keeps_every_reported_row[Benin]
 42.54s setup  test_table_structure.py::TestHousingVDtype::test_to_parquet_succeeds[Tanzania]
 42.54s call   test_currency.py::test_feature_ghana_per_wave
 42.47s call   test_gh323_benin_togo.py::test_plot_inputs_keeps_every_reported_row[Togo]
```

**42.47s to 45.13s — a 2.7-second spread across twenty entries**, spanning Tanzania, Benin, Togo, Uganda, GhanaLSS, Kazakhstan, currency, visualizations, table structure, and both `setup` and `call` phases.

Tests doing genuinely different work do not land within three seconds of one another twenty times. That is a **fixed budget being waited out** — the retry/timeout path to S3 — which is exactly the expensive skip route this issue describes. The per-test cost is now a measured number rather than an inference: **~43 s each.**

Caveat, stated plainly: I have not instrumented the call to prove the 43 s is boto3's retry budget specifically. What is proven is that it is a constant, not computation. Anyone doing the marking work should confirm the mechanism on one file before doing all 56.

## Two entries that are NOT the band, and want separate attention

* `test_feature_canonical_index.py::test_warm_corpus_assembly_loses_no_rows` — **512 s in one test**, over 10x the band. Not a timeout; that is real work, and it is 5% of the whole job on its own.
* `test_sample.py::test_index_is_i_t[Albania]` at **257 s in `setup`**, with `[Azerbaijan]` at 74 s and `[Ethiopia]` at 43 s — the same parametrised fixture costing wildly different amounts per country, which suggests the first parameter pays a shared build the rest inherit.

Neither is fixed by marking. Both are worth a look once the 56 files are marked and the band is gone.

title: 80% of CI's skipped tests take the expensive skip path: 56 files reach a skip via a network timeout instead of a requires_s3 mark
